choices.de: Noch nicht. Ich bin die Dunkelheit um vier nicht gewohnt.

reply.en: You will be. Two winters, and you'll be one of us.
reply.sl: Boš. Dve zimi in boš {m:eden|f:ena} od nas.
reply.it: Lo sarai. Due inverni, e sarai {m:uno|f:una} di noi.
reply.de: Wirst du. Zwei Winter, und du gehörst zu uns.

choices.en: Not yet. I don't used to the dark at four o'clock.
choices.sl: Še ne. Nisem {m:navajen|f:navajena}, da je ob štirih tema.
choices.it: Non ancora. Non sono {m:abituato|f:abituata} al buio alle quattro.
choices.de: Noch nicht. Ich bin die Dunkelheit um vier nicht gewohnt.

why.en: Be used to + a noun or -ing: I'm not used to the dark. It needs be, not do.
why.sl: Be used to + samostalnik ali -ing: I'm not used to the dark. Potrebuje be, ne do.
why.it: Be used to + un nome o -ing: I'm not used to the dark. Vuole be, non do.
why.de: Be used to + Nomen oder -ing: I'm not used to the dark. Es braucht be, nicht do.

reply.en: Don't used to? Oh, love, my ears. Once more?
reply.sl: Don't used to? Oh, moja ušesa. Še enkrat?
reply.it: Don't used to? Oh, le mie orecchie. Ancora una volta?
reply.de: Don't used to? Ach, meine Ohren. Noch mal?

lines.en: I hated the dark too, when I was small. Then my mother taught me to love the fire.
lines.sl: Tudi jaz sem sovražila temo, ko sem bila majhna. Potem me je mama naučila ljubiti ogenj.
lines.it: Anch'io odiavo il buio da piccola. Poi mia madre mi ha insegnato ad amare il fuoco.
lines.de: Ich hab die Dunkelheit als Kind auch gehasst. Dann hat mir meine Mutter beigebracht, das Feuer zu lieben.

lines.en: You don't really mind it now, do you?
lines.sl: Zdaj te pa v resnici ne moti več, kajne?
lines.it: Adesso in fondo non ti dispiace, vero?
lines.de: Jetzt macht es dir eigentlich nichts mehr aus, oder?

choices.en: I did hate it when I first came. Now I love the fire.
choices.sl: Ko sem {m:prišel|f:prišla}, sem jo res {m:sovražil|f:sovražila}. Zdaj imam {m:rad|f:rada} ogenj.
choices.it: Quando sono {m:arrivato|f:arrivata}, la odiavo davvero. Adesso amo il fuoco.
choices.de: Als ich herkam, hab ich sie wirklich gehasst. Jetzt liebe ich das Feuer.

reply.en: That's the way. Winter's for fires and friends.
reply.sl: Tako je prav. Zima je za ogenj in prijatelje.
reply.it: Così si fa. L'inverno è per il fuoco e gli amici.
reply.de: So ist's recht. Der Winter ist für Feuer und Freunde.

choices.en: I did hated it when I first came. Now I love the fire.
choices.sl: Ko sem {m:prišel|f:prišla}, sem jo res {m:sovražil|f:sovražila}. Zdaj imam {m:rad|f:rada} ogenj.
choices.it: Quando sono {m:arrivato|f:arrivata}, la odiavo davvero. Adesso amo il fuoco.
choices.de: Als ich herkam, hab ich sie wirklich gehasst. Jetzt liebe ich das Feuer.

why.en: Do or did + the base form, said with weight: I did hate it. The past is already in did.
why.sl: Do ali did + osnovna oblika, s poudarkom: I did hate it. Preteklost je že v did.
why.it: Do o did + la forma base, con enfasi: I did hate it. Il passato è già in did.
why.de: Do oder did + Grundform, mit Nachdruck: I did hate it. Die Vergangenheit steckt schon in did.

reply.en: Did hated? Oh, love. Once more, nice and slow.
reply.sl: Did hated? Oh. Še enkrat, lepo počasi.
reply.it: Did hated? Oh, {m:caro|f:cara}. Ancora una volta, piano piano.
reply.de: Did hated? Ach, Schätzchen. Noch mal, schön langsam.

lines.en: More chocolate? There's always more chocolate.
lines.sl: Še čokolade? Čokolade je vedno še.
lines.it: Ancora cioccolata? Di cioccolata ce n'è sempre.
lines.de: Noch Schokolade? Schokolade gibt's immer noch.

memory.en: my mother's hot chocolate with a pinch of salt
memory.sl: mamino vročo čokolado s ščepcem soli
memory.it: la cioccolata calda di mia madre con un pizzico di sale
memory.de: die heiße Schokolade meiner Mutter mit einer Prise Salz

lines.en: Good evening, love! Are you cold? Here's a mug of hot chocolate. My mother's recipe.
lines.sl: Dober večer! Te zebe? Tu imaš skodelico vroče čokolade. Po maminem receptu.
lines.it: Buonasera, {m:caro|f:cara}! Hai freddo? Ecco una tazza di cioccolata calda. La ricetta di mia madre.
lines.de: Guten Abend, Schätzchen! Ist dir kalt? Hier, ein Becher heiße Schokolade. Das Rezept meiner Mutter.

lines.en: Can you guess what's in it?
lines.sl: Uganeš, kaj je v njej?
lines.it: Indovini che cosa c'è dentro?
lines.de: Rätst du, was drin ist?

choices.en: Is it made with milk and a bit of cinnamon?
choices.sl: Je narejena z mlekom in malo cimeta?
choices.it: È fatta con latte e un po' di cannella?
choices.de: Ist sie mit Milch und ein bisschen Zimt gemacht?

reply.en: Milk, cinnamon and a pinch of salt. That's the secret, love.
reply.sl: Mleko, cimet in ščepec soli. To je skrivnost.
reply.it: Latte, cannella e un pizzico di sale. È quello il segreto.
reply.de: Milch, Zimt und eine Prise Salz. Das ist das Geheimnis.

choices.en: Is it make with milk and a bit of cinnamon?
choices.sl: Je narejena z mlekom in malo cimeta?
choices.it: È fatta con latte e un po' di cannella?
choices.de: Ist sie mit Milch und ein bisschen Zimt gemacht?

why.en: The passive is be + the participle: is it made with …? Make is the base form.
why.sl: Trpnik je be + deležnik: is it made with …? Make je osnovna oblika.
why.it: Il passivo è be + il participio: is it made with …? Make è la forma base.
why.de: Das Passiv ist be + Partizip: is it made with …? Make ist die Grundform.

reply.en: Is it make? Oh, love, my old ears. Once more?
reply.sl: Is it make? Oh, moja stara ušesa. Še enkrat?
reply.it: Is it make? Oh, le mie vecchie orecchie. Ancora?
reply.de: Is it make? Ach, meine alten Ohren. Noch mal?

lines.en: I've been making it like this since I was ten.
lines.sl: Tako jo kuham, odkar sem imela deset let.
lines.it: La faccio così da quando avevo dieci anni.
lines.de: Ich mache sie so, seit ich zehn war.

lines.en: And you? How long have you liked hot chocolate?
lines.sl: Pa ti? Kako dolgo že imaš {m:rad|f:rada} vročo čokolado?
lines.it: E tu? Da quanto ti piace la cioccolata calda?
lines.de: Und du? Seit wann magst du heiße Schokolade?

choices.en: For as long as I can remember!
choices.de: Solange ich denken kann!

reply.en: That's the best answer. Have another, then.
reply.sl: To je najboljši odgovor. Potem pa še eno.
reply.it: È la risposta migliore. Allora prendine un'altra.
reply.de: Das ist die beste Antwort. Dann nimm noch eine.

choices.en: Since as long as I can remember!
choices.de: Solange ich denken kann!

why.en: For goes with how long: for as long as I can remember. Since needs a starting time: since I was ten.
why.sl: For gre s tem, kako dolgo: for as long as I can remember. Since potrebuje začetek: since I was ten.
why.it: For va con la durata: for as long as I can remember. Since vuole un inizio: since I was ten.
why.de: For steht bei der Dauer: for as long as I can remember. Since braucht einen Anfang: since I was ten.

reply.en: Since as long? Since when, love?
reply.sl: Since as long? Od kdaj pa?
reply.it: Since as long? Da quando, {m:caro|f:cara}?
reply.de: Since as long? Seit wann denn, Schätzchen?

lines.en: There. Warm hands, warm heart. Now sit by the fire.
lines.sl: Tako. Tople roke, toplo srce. Zdaj pa sedi k ognju.
lines.it: Ecco. Mani calde, cuore caldo. Ora siediti accanto al fuoco.
lines.de: So. Warme Hände, warmes Herz. Jetzt setz dich ans Feuer.

memory.it: le notizie di Harry accanto al fuoco

lines.en: Evening, love! Sit down. Harry was here a minute ago, full of news.
lines.sl: Dober večer! Sedi. Harry je bil pravkar tu, poln novic.
lines.it: Buonasera, {m:caro|f:cara}! Siediti. Harry era qui un minuto fa, pieno di notizie.
lines.de: Abend, Schätzchen! Setz dich. Harry war vor einer Minute hier, voller Neuigkeiten.

lines.en: He shouted something at you on his way out. What was it?
lines.sl: Ko je odhajal, ti je nekaj zavpil. Kaj?
lines.it: Uscendo ti ha gridato qualcosa. Che cosa?
lines.de: Beim Rausgehen hat er dir was zugerufen. Was war's?

choices.en: He said he was going to listen to Wilf's story too.
choices.sl: Rekel je, da bo tudi on poslušal Wilfovo zgodbo.
choices.it: Ha detto che anche lui avrebbe ascoltato la storia di Wilf.
choices.de: Er hat gesagt, er hört sich Wilfs Geschichte auch an.

reply.en: Then we'll all listen. Wilf likes a full fire.
reply.sl: Potem bomo poslušali vsi. Wilf ima rad poln ogenj.
reply.it: Allora ascolteremo tutti. A Wilf piace il fuoco pieno di gente.
reply.de: Dann hören wir alle zu. Wilf mag ein volles Feuer.

choices.en: He said I was going to listen to Wilf's story too.
choices.sl: Rekel je, da bom tudi jaz {m:poslušal|f:poslušala} Wilfovo zgodbo.
choices.it: Ha detto che anch'io avrei ascoltato la storia di Wilf.
choices.de: Er hat gesagt, ich höre mir Wilfs Geschichte auch an.

why.en: Harry spoke of himself: »I'm going to listen« becomes he was going to listen.
why.sl: Harry je govoril o sebi: »I'm going to listen« postane he was going to listen.
why.it: Harry parlava di sé: »I'm going to listen« diventa he was going to listen.
why.de: Harry sprach von sich: »I'm going to listen« wird zu he was going to listen.

reply.en: You're going to? Well, you're very welcome, love!
reply.sl: You're going to? No, {m:dobrodošel|f:dobrodošla} si!
reply.it: You're going to? Be', sei {m:il benvenuto|f:la benvenuta}!
reply.de: You're going to? Na, du bist herzlich willkommen!

lines.en: Wilf's eighty-four, and he still tells a story better than anyone.
lines.sl: Wilf ima štiriinosemdeset let in še vedno pripoveduje bolje od vseh.
lines.it: Wilf ha ottantaquattro anni e racconta ancora meglio di chiunque altro.
lines.de: Wilf ist vierundachtzig und erzählt immer noch besser als jeder andere.

lines.en: Why do the children love his stories, do you think?
lines.sl: Zakaj imajo otroci tako radi njegove zgodbe, kaj misliš?
lines.it: Perché ai bambini piacciono tanto le sue storie, secondo te?
lines.de: Warum lieben die Kinder seine Geschichten, was meinst du?

choices.en: He speaks slowly so that everyone can follow.
choices.sl: Govori počasi, da mu lahko vsi sledijo.
choices.it: Parla piano, così tutti possono seguirlo.
choices.de: Er spricht langsam, damit alle mitkommen.

reply.en: Slowly, aye. Like the beck in summer.
reply.sl: Počasi, ja. Kot potok poleti.
reply.it: Piano, sì. Come il torrente d'estate.
reply.de: Langsam, ja. Wie der Bach im Sommer.

choices.en: He speaks slowly for that everyone can follow.
choices.sl: Govori počasi, da mu lahko vsi sledijo.
choices.it: Parla piano, così tutti possono seguirlo.
choices.de: Er spricht langsam, damit alle mitkommen.

why.en: For a purpose: so that + a sentence, so that everyone can follow. For goes with a noun: for the children.
why.sl: Za namen: so that + stavek, so that everyone can follow. For gre s samostalnikom: for the children.
why.it: Per uno scopo: so that + una frase, so that everyone can follow. For va con un nome: for the children.
why.de: Für einen Zweck: so that + ein Satz, so that everyone can follow. For steht bei einem Nomen: for the children.

reply.en: For that? For what, love?
reply.sl: For that? Za kaj pa?
reply.it: For that? Per cosa, {m:caro|f:cara}?
reply.de: For that? Wofür denn, Schätzchen?

lines.en: Drink up, then. He'll start any minute.
lines.sl: Kar popij. Vsak hip bo začel.
lines.it: Bevi, allora. Comincerà da un momento all'altro.
lines.de: Trink aus. Er fängt gleich an.
